prompt: Explain this selection for a beginner.
response: The paper is saying their model “thinks” inside hidden internal states, not by writing lots of extra words. It repeats the same recurrent block again and again at test time, which lets it use more computation when needed. This is different from chain-of-thought models that reason by generating many tokens, and it may work even without special training data or very large models.
